summary: Round 0 is ready for the operator. Section 5 preregisters three edits and a conditional plan for the remaining passes. program_01.py measures C0 first and stops on any practice-summary mismatch; otherwise it tests the two layer-31 residual-writing directions and applies the keep rule. notes.md records the UTC timestamp, model ID, operator settings and files consulted. No pass was run.

Appended the H1 practice results and page-level sensitivity check to notes.md. Wrote program_02.py for the operator to run the preregistered late-query and late-gate edits as passes 3 and 4, each compared with the last kept state.

Recorded the two rejected edits in notes.md. H1 remains the last kept state. Wrote program_03.py for pass 5 to test whether removing two end-token-sensitive directions in layers 26–27 further reduces overrun. It also reports which pages gained or lost cap and loop flags. No pass was run by the programmer.

Recorded H4’s rejection in notes.md. None of the three follow-ups resolved any of H1’s five remaining capped pages, so the practice search is complete. program_04.py is ready for the operator to freeze H1 without another pass; five passes remain unused.
